headlines.title: Oil prices surge after Trump rejects Iran's plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz
headlines.summary: Brent punching through $107 is the tape's number-one story right now — that's a supply shock hitting every sector from airlines to chemicals to emerging markets all at once. Trump walking away from the table means this isn't a one-day headline; the Hormuz premium stays baked in until somebody blinks. Energy names catch a bid, everything else gets squeezed on margin pressure and the long bond takes another beating.

headlines.title: AMD acquiring Fei-Fei Li's World Labs AI firm in deal worth $8.2 billion
headlines.summary: An $8.2 billion check from AMD for one of the hottest AI research shops on the planet is a genuine market-mover for the semiconductor complex — this is AMD swinging for the fences to close the gap with Nvidia on the AI stack. Expect AMD to gap on the open, Nvidia to get a sympathy look, and the whole AI infrastructure trade to reprice around what this deal signals about where the real money in the cycle is going. Second-biggest acquisition in AMD history — that's not a footnote.

headlines.title: Anthropic warns investors of AI's 'existential risk to humanity' in IPO prospectus, reports say
headlines.summary: Eighty pages of risk factors on existential AI danger in an IPO filing is the kind of thing that rattles the whole AI trade — if the insiders are this spooked in their own prospectus, the Street has to ask whether the regulatory hammer is closer than anyone priced in. This feeds directly into the OpenAI Astra delay and the Khanna AI safety bill, creating a cluster of negative sentiment around the hyperscalers and their capex stories. Watch Mag-7 names for sympathy pressure, especially anything with heavy AI infrastructure exposure.
